messages:
priya: FYI - ACME legal just pushed a hard ask for per-tenant retention tiers + BYOK integration before their pilot. We need clear acceptance criteria, risk notes for sales, and a quick cost delta for Q2 planning. cc @kevin @elaine @nate :eyes:
kevin: quick q - do they need searchable logs for the full retention window or is export-only ok for >365d? also any SLA they care about (search latency / availability)?
priya: they said searchable for 90d, exportable for up to 3y. SLA ask was vague: "near-immediate" for 90d searches; happy to set concrete numbers.
elaine: for exports/legal-hold we need an ops playbook + retention toggle per tenant. BYOK adds escrow/legal constraints (can't decrypt without handshake proof). Also: regional residency for a subset of customers.
nate: ballpark infra delta: warm searchable index (90d) ~ $8k/mo for 5TB, cold-archive+restore pipeline ~ $4k/mo, ops overhead ~ $1k/mo. + one-time engineering ~ 2-3 eng-weeks for export/playbook + BYOK handshake flow.
miguel: from field side - ACME will require a documented evidence export API and manifest for chain-of-custody. Suggested export payload (example):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/v1/admin/exports" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp","from":"2023-01-01","to":"2023-12-31","format":"zip","include_kms_proof":true}'
```
miguel: also propose a soft-degrade plan: searchable index = 90d SLA 99.5% <30s; 90-365d = limited quick-export (index sampled) with ~4h restore; >365d = cold ZIP export with 24-72h restore. reduces cost while meeting most enterprise asks.
kevin: technical risks: BYOK handshake complexity (escrow + key rotation), indexing cost for variable retention, and discovery/search privacy when combining regional datasets. Need decision: do we surface retention tiers as self-serve or enterprise-only gated feature?
priya: decision proposal: 1) Acceptance criteria: BYOK handshake docs + test harness, per-tenant retention tiers (90/365/3y), export API + manifest, legal-hold toggle, regional residency flag. 2) SLAs: 90d search 99.5% <30s; exports 4h for <365d, 48h for >365d (cold). 3) Prioritization: P1 for enterprise onboarding (pilot customers), P2 for self-serve in 2 quarters. 4) Owners: eng-security (kevin) for BYOK, eng-ops (elaine) for export/playbook, product (priya) for acceptance docs.
compliance-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 control mapping and audit evidence list to the ticket before any pilot begins.
priya: Great - I'll capture this into the roadmap doc and create a short PRD with the acceptance criteria + cost delta. Nate - can you add the cost numbers to the shared sheet? Kevin/elaine/miguel please flag any blockers by EOD. :white_check_mark:
